## ba32e05911b0

**Reproduced lesson ambiguity.** Seed `10`, difficulty `medium`, default sample indices `0`, `1`, and `2` are all `clear_climb`. A plausible rival—trace each bottom color-6 marker straight upward in its original column, never rolling at orange ledges—matches the selected Racket output exactly on all three demonstrations. Default sample `3` is `long_roll` and disagrees at 35 cells.

The four inputs are all emitted by the current sampler and pass `self_check`. `checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/counterexample.json` stores profiles, generator/rule hashes, inputs, Racket outputs, rival output, exact difference coordinates, and the supported apply command. The evidence therefore establishes an actual consecutive three-demo window, not merely a hypothetical input outside the sampler.

**Recommendation.** Add a deterministic lesson schedule and executable rivals so every allowed demonstration window includes at least one roll, with stop/multi-roll branches covered at the chosen lesson length. No target files were changed in this review.

## ba32e05911b0

**Reproduced an unresolved teaching ambiguity on the current source.** Default sampler seed `10`, difficulty `medium`, indices `0`, `1`, and `2` all produce `clear_climb` scenes. A straight-up rival that traces each bottom color-6 marker in its original column and never rolls matches the actual selected Racket outputs on all three demonstrations. Index `3` produces `long_roll`; the rival disagrees with the actual query output at 35 cells.

All four inputs are unmodified default generated draws and pass `self_check`. The generator declares no `EXAMPLES_NEEDED`, so this is an actual native three-demonstration lesson. The supported wrapper `arcpuzzles apply` command executed the canonical rule successfully; its receipt confirms generator SHA-256 `e71e4c26811b60906e4725b9f885f81a27857baeedb267234b8de7be59621345` and executed rule hash `96b86f6cf562`. The Python mirror agrees with Racket on all four inputs.

This reproduces the existing audit retained in `repo/generators/ba32e05911b0/evidence/review_index.json` against exactly the same source; it is not a new distinct finding. The rival is refuted by canonical rolling examples, so the finding is a generated teaching flaw rather than a canonical-fitting shortcut.

**Recommendation.** Add a deterministic lesson schedule with explicit no-roll rivals. Require rolling examples in every allowed demonstration window; for arbitrary query holdouts, ensure at least two refuting examples per materialized lesson. Retain stop and multiple-roll teaching coverage. No target or shared source was changed.

Reproduction and complete evidence: `checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/reproduce.py`, `input.json`, `rival.json`, `racket.json`, `finalize.py`, and `evidence.json`. The evidence records full grids, exact differences, source/rule hashes, validator acceptance, domain membership, and commands with working directories and exit codes. Probe scope: four generated pairs and one declared rival; no full battery.


### Completed reproduction commands

Invoked from the packet root, `/workspace/scratch/da15bfe0ea6e/packet`:

```bash
python3 checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/reproduce.py
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply ba32e05911b0 \
  --input ../checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/input.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/racket.json
python3 checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/finalize.py
```

All three completed with exit code `0`; the wrapper payload ran from `packet/repo`. Exact commands, directories, results and hashes are retained in `checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/evidence.json`, with the authoritative apply receipt in `racket.json`.

## ba32e05911b0

**Reproduced teaching ambiguity; no audit-target source changed.** Generator SHA-256 `e71e4c26811b60906e4725b9f885f81a27857baeedb267234b8de7be59621345`; executed rule hash `96b86f6cf562`.

For seed `10`, difficulty `medium`, default sample indices `0`, `1`, and `2` are all `clear_climb`. A plausible simpler rival—trace each bottom color-6 marker straight upward in its original column, painting zero path cells color 2 and never rolling right across a clear orange ledge—matches the selected Racket output on all three demonstrations. Default sample `3` is an emitted `long_roll` witness and disagrees with that rival at 22 cells. All four inputs are ordinary generator emissions and pass `self_check`.

Evidence: `checks/audit/ba32e05911b0/counterexample.json`, generated inputs in `input.json`, and supported Racket execution in `racket.json`. This confirms an actual consecutive three-demo ambiguity, not merely an out-of-domain hypothetical. A future repair should schedule at least one roll-bearing example in every production lesson and declare the straight-climb rival explicitly.
